sentences: After the day, look at what actually happened.
If you did the Protector action(s), not feeling better right away is information to learn from.
Healing is nonlinear, and sometimes standing up for yourself might make you feel worse at first.
Not doing it is harder to figure out.
Fear is the first guess, but maybe you didn't know how or why.
Or you were just worn out, or whoever said they'd help couldn't make it.
